dialogues.text: Speak the password, and the path will open.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, it didn't respond. Guess we need to figure out the password before we can get in... And whatever you're thinking, it's definitely not anything written on the door!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we listen in on some of the Eremites nearby? They might have some clues for us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on! No one's going to set such a simple password! The words on this gate aren't it either!
